newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade quiet. Not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for a market test. Inquiry moderate, demand light, USDA said. Confirmed - 100.
Sales confirmed on 100 mixed steers and heifers. This week's confirmed sales 76,600 head including 20,800 head or about 27 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Pen mixed slaughter steers and heifers Commercial to Choice with end heiferettes 1125 lbs 61.00.
